entry.name: writing-style
entry.description: Use the owner's writing style for drafting, revision, style review, or proposing profile updates. Select one primary genre; raw writing samples are not loaded automatically.

tasks.name: writing-style-draft
tasks.label: 起草
tasks.description: Draft in the owner's writing style using supplied facts and one selected genre. Mark missing material instead of inventing facts or experiences.

tasks.name: writing-style-revise
tasks.label: 润色
tasks.description: Revise expression in the owner's style while preserving facts, numerical values, formulas, code, citations and identity boundaries.

tasks.name: writing-style-review
tasks.label: 风格复核
tasks.description: Review style with short quotations from the submitted draft, separated observations and suggestions, without invented similarity percentages.

tasks.name: writing-style-feedback
tasks.label: 更新建议
tasks.description: Compare the user's original and edited text and propose evidence-based style rule changes for human confirmation; never apply them automatically.

genres.name: writing-style-work-summary
genres.label: 工作复盘
genres.description: Genre guidance for work summaries and retrospectives: task-specific effects, constraints and grounded personal observations.

genres.name: writing-style-conference-report
genres.label: 会议技术报告
genres.description: Genre guidance for conference reports: relevance-based selection, source attribution and implications for the current work.

genres.name: writing-style-technical-note
genres.label: 技术学习笔记
genres.description: Genre guidance for technical learning notes: comparisons, intermediate artifacts and explanations without mandatory final-summary templates.

genres.name: writing-style-numerical-development
genres.label: 数值算法实现参考
genres.description: Genre guidance for numerical implementation notes: mathematical relations, execution mapping, constraints and implementation status distinct from validation.

genres.name: writing-style-personal-narrative
genres.label: 个人叙事与致谢
genres.description: Genre guidance for personal narratives and acknowledgments: real experiences, direct feelings and relationship-dependent tone; humor and self-reflection remain optional candidates.
